tldr: Midday batch (Sep 7) — Anthropic's $2T IPO firms up: FT reports half a dozen backers expect an October float topping SpaceX's $1.77T record debut, Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs closing in as leads, S-1 paperwork could hit the SEC this week — backers model $100-120B exit-2026 revenue at ~30x sales. On benchmarks, ARC Prize ran Astra itself and found the 'AGI has arrived' number was harness-dependent: 62.7% under the standard harness vs 99.9% under OpenAI's adapter — same weights, different scaffolding, and even a zero-reasoning adapter run beat the max-reasoning standard one. Teknium discloses the full scale of the Hermes Agent self-refactor: 400,000 lines removed via 1,396 recursive subagents over 19 hours on one desktop, merged to prod a day later with almost no issues — the recursive-subagent reliability story keeps scaling.
